IRU_HEAT.title: Heat
IRU_HEAT.description:
Heat increases damage received by the same percentage. 
At the start of your turn, lose 20% of your Heat plus 10. 
If you took no HP damage since your previous turn, gain Hyper equal to the Heat lost this way.
IRU_HYPER.title: Hyper
IRU_HYPER.description:
Current Hyper: %HYPER%/%MAXHYPER%. 
Gain 10 Hyper whenever you play a card. 
Spending Heat also grants Hyper.
